categories.name: Visual hierarchy
categories.rationale: Primary board task is clear; Account gives persistent guidance almost the same ink priority as actions, and Sign In's uniform spacing weakens field grouping. Passing geometry does not establish calm.

categories.name: Spacing/grid
categories.rationale: Consistent native gutters and safe insets; Account compact section rhythm and the capacity footer's 18pt/30pt leading-edge mismatch remain visible. See density tasks.

categories.name: Typography scale
categories.rationale: System styles and persistent Password heading are legible; hierarchy needs refinement without reducing sizes. Short Island strings now fit through native tightening.

categories.name: Dynamic Type
categories.rationale: Default/XXXL matrices preserve complete board paragraphs, full-width capacity status and Account guidance. Larger accessibility sizes AX1–5 remain unobserved.

categories.name: Light contrast
categories.rationale: Strong enabled text, controls and errors across normal/combined settings; native raster gates support the inspected samples, not every wallpaper or disabled fixture.

categories.name: Dark contrast
categories.rationale: Dark surfaces preserve clear text and controls, including errors and guidance. Disabled fixture paint is distinguished from enabled production appearance.

categories.name: Iconography
categories.rationale: Recognizable SF Symbols, original Notepad icon and native provider branding. Reorder grips are understandable but add a recurring visual column.

categories.name: Safe area / Dynamic Island
categories.rationale: Inspected title bands and Island content clear system boundaries. Account/Sign In use native hard edges; board's custom 24pt mask is not claimed to reproduce Apple's blur.

categories.name: Scroll/pull-down / last row
categories.rationale: Post-refresh final-row ink is complete above composer at both sizes/styles; new actual legal-footer gestures resolve prior reachability evidence mismatch.

categories.name: List rows
categories.rationale: Native separators, dedicated completion target and accessible reorder actions are strong. Permanent trailing grips narrow the text column relative to Apple; long fixture copy amplifies this.

categories.name: Empty states
categories.rationale: All Clear is clear and composition removes setup instructions. First-run guide is substantially denser than Apple's empty list, especially XXXL, but remains purposeful and dismissible.

categories.name: Composer ergonomics
categories.rationale: Draft-preserving Done and 44pt controls work in evidence. Full-capacity no-Add behavior is correct; status/help ordering and different left edges still need polish.

categories.name: Keyboard handling
categories.rationale: Normal and actual combined-settings secure-field supplements show complete keyboards, persistent label and Done. Focus/pan geometry passes; live AutoFill is unobserved.

categories.name: Sheet presentation/detents
categories.rationale: Account medium/large, scrolled title bands, reopening large and onscreen Done >=44pt are supported. Apple's available Details references are large detents only.

categories.name: Navigation clarity
categories.rationale: Single board, clear Account entry/Done, explicit provider/email choices and legal actions. No mistaken navigation failure inferred from inert demos.

categories.name: Touch targets
categories.rationale: Source and native assertions support completion/grip/Add/Done and legal targets; Account 46pt local Done remains >=44pt after medium-sheet scaling.

categories.name: Haptics
categories.rationale: Selection/completion/auth feedback has sensible source placement, but no physical tactile assessment was performed.

categories.name: Animation/transitions
categories.rationale: Nine recordings sampled at three distributed times support sensible end states and transitions; samples cannot certify cadence or absence of transient hitches.

categories.name: Loading states
categories.rationale: Clear centered board loading and layout-preserving authentication progress. Source prevents label collapse; no live network latency assessment.

categories.name: Error states
categories.rationale: Readable, actionable board/auth/account recovery without decorative warning colors. Raw network error wording is intentionally preserved as requested; local recovery is not live authentication proof.

categories.name: VoiceOver/labels
categories.rationale: Dedicated labels, full reminder text, position/action semantics and announcement policies are supported in source/AX evidence. Spoken order and rotor use remain unobserved.

categories.name: iOS HIG consistency
categories.rationale: Native List, sheet detents, provider control and keyboard treatments are convincing. Account information hierarchy and custom board edge remain distinct from Apple reference behavior.

categories.name: Lock Screen / Live Activity
categories.rationale: Short XXXL expanded strings now both complete with +8; banner and constrained Island preserve count budgets. Very long tails truncate and compact/minimal are intentionally empty; true locked hardware is unobserved.

categories.name: Sign-in/onboarding
categories.rationale: Persistent Password labeling, native provider paint and verified footer reachability are strong. Equal 12pt internal spacing and prominent helper copy make the XXXL password stack feel busier than necessary.

categories.name: Settings/account
categories.rationale: Mechanically complete and accessible at both detents, but passive identity pill, compact successive sections and primary-ink persistent prose compete with settings actions. Highest density priority.

categories.name: Performance feel
categories.rationale: Fresh five-sample public metrics establish a simulator baseline only. Host load, XCTest overhead and unexplained 1389.957s keyboard-method outlier preclude a responsiveness certification.

categories.name: Delight
categories.rationale: Direct composition, completion and restrained monochrome treatment are pleasant. Repeated chrome and guidance reduce calm in Account/Sign In; no hardware-feel evidence.

categories.name: Long text
categories.rationale: Main-board paragraphs and Account guidance remain complete; stress seed is not representative content density. Island intentionally uses one-line tails for genuinely long content.

categories.name: Reduced Motion / Transparency
categories.rationale: Actual combined-system-setting matrices and all-three-method teardown restoration support the implementation; solid 6pt board edge is explicit. No physical motion sensitivity evaluation.

categories.name: Palette / minimalism
categories.rationale: Restrained monochrome surfaces and functional tint respect the brief, with no nested cards or decorative red/orange. Low color count alone does not cure Account's visual density.

findings.title: Account's persistent guidance and repeated groups compete with its controls
findings.screen: Account, default and XXXL; large top, scrolled persistence, expanded guidance and medium detent
findings.basis: Observed screenshots plus source-derived cause; subjective hierarchy judgment, not a clipping or contrast failure.
findings.confidence: high for observed density; medium for proposed visual improvement until side-by-side acceptance
findings.detail: Default Account presents a passive identity pill, notification pill/footer, persistence header and five-row group, then two primary-ink paragraphs before Sign Out and legal groups. At XXXL the explanatory prose becomes a dominant block. Apple's Details has comparable native rows but clearer section pauses and much less persistent helper prose; semantics differ, so exact row-count parity is not a target.
findings.fix: In AccountView remove the global compact section-spacing override and render the passive identity row with a clear row background while retaining avatar, wording and layout. Keep interactive groups native. Give the persistence-to-Sign Out boundary at least 16pt measured separation, distinct from the preserved 6pt gap within the two exact paragraphs. In BoardPersistenceSection and notification footer, evaluate a secondary helper ink token at unchanged footnote size with >=4.5:1 measured contrast in both styles and combined settings; retain primary ink for errors/actions. Do not hide paragraphs, move them behind a disclosure, introduce new headings/copy, or create nested cards.
findings.programmatic_check: Retain exact paragraph strings once each, 6pt internal gap and full ideal heights. Add native probes for passive identity background and >=16pt semantic boundary; raster-check helper >=4.5:1 and distinct luminance from primary actions under normal/combined settings. Re-run AccountChromeUITests including medium/large Done>=44, recovery, scrolled title bands, all Settings teardown checks and full iOS suite. Compare unchanged-content default/XXXL captures with the Apple pairs and ask user to assess calm; metrics cannot substitute for that judgment.

findings.title: Sign In needs field grouping rather than one uniform vertical rhythm
findings.screen: Sign In password variant, default/XXXL, initial/bottom and normal/combined keyboard
findings.basis: Observed presentation and source-derived equal 12pt child spacing. Actual scrolling succeeds; not an unreachable-footer defect.
findings.confidence: high for equal spacing and XXXL stack; medium for taste severity
findings.detail: Default has sufficient open space, so a blanket 'everything is cramped' claim would be inaccurate. In XXXL the headings, helpers, input surfaces, primary action and alternate action form a dense sequence with too little difference between within-field and between-field gaps. Apple compose is only a keyboard/form reference, not a matching authentication flow.
findings.fix: Replace the flat emailSection content rhythm with invisible layout groups: Email heading/helper/field as one group, Password heading/field/helper as another, and primary/alternate actions as a third. Use 6pt label-to-field/helper spacing within groups and 16pt between field groups, preserving the existing 24pt separation from providers and 48pt Password/alternate/Done targets. Keep every string, one secure field, provider branding and footer. Use source-owned helper styling only if contrast remains >=4.5:1; do not shrink type or force XXXL onto one viewport.
findings.programmatic_check: Probe internal gaps at 6pt and between-group gaps >=16pt; exact-copy snapshot and one secure field/one visible Password heading. Preserve existing 48pt targets and loading-label geometry. Re-run normal+combined keyboard, Done/draft, three fresh provider launches, enabled paint/inertness and ordinary actual gesture matrix. Require real XXXL displacement and every legal link >=8pt above safe bottom, plus full iOS suite. User comparison determines improved calm.

findings.title: Full-board footer reads as two disconnected blocks
findings.screen: Board at seven reminders, default/XXXL and both appearances
source: ios/App/ReminderListView.swift: composer capacityHint and capacity branch
findings.basis: Observed hint/status left-edge difference plus source-derived 18pt versus 30pt leading insets; crowding partly caused by synthetic long paragraphs.
findings.confidence: high for alignment/order; medium for proposed hierarchy benefit
findings.detail: The long explanatory hint precedes the concise full-board status; the status starts 12pt farther right. Together they occupy a persistent footer while the text column also reserves a trailing grip. No Add at capacity, full-width scaling and final-row clearance are already correct. Apple's floating Add is a different workflow, not a reason to remove the capacity explanation.
findings.fix: Create a dedicated static capacity layout in ReminderListView, with the unchanged status first and unchanged hint second, a 6pt gap and a shared leading edge at 18pt from the composer container. Retain full available width, Dynamic Type and the existing >=44pt status reserve initially; remove only input-specific asymmetric padding from this non-input branch. Keep no Add/input at capacity. Do not alter normal composer or shrink row text.
findings.programmatic_check: Update the intentional capacity inset assertions to the new shared 18pt edge, retaining ideal-height/contrast checks, no Add/text field, exactly one status/hint and >=44pt status reserve. Require footer total height no greater than baseline for the same type/content and final-row ink completely above composer after pull. Re-run all four capacity transitions, draft Done preservation, edge/AX checks and full iOS suite; review matched-content board captures before any grip redesign.

recordings_sampled.claim: Distributed-frame inspection only, not full playback or smoothness certification

evidence_gaps: Physical haptics, spoken VoiceOver/rotor traversal, true locked-device Activity, wallpaper matrix, AX1–5, live authentication and AutoFill were not observed.
Nine recordings were inspected through three distributed samples each; no frame pacing or hitch metric was measured.

Public launch/scroll five-sample simulator metrics include host/XCTest effects. Normal keyboard test's unexplained 1389.957s outlier and earlier timeout/interruption records remain; pass is not responsiveness proof.
Historical protected XCTest password screenshots are partial. Full-device native normal/combined keyboard and populated-password captures supply complete selected visual evidence.

Apple references have content/semantic/configuration gaps: no auth/loading/error/Activity equivalent, no exact medium-detent or combined-settings pair, and some empty states lack size/appearance match. App paragraphs are much longer than Apple list seeds.
Dense explanatory copy and visual hierarchy require user acceptance. Passing geometry/contrast, or any future overall >=9, does not establish calm.
round5_dispositions: Prior short XXXL Island second-line truncation is resolved in the supplied native P evidence: both short lines complete and +8 remains. Very long tails still truncate by native one-line policy; manual word truncation candidate M remains rejected.

N preserves no Add at capacity and full-width scaled status; O preserves native hard edge, 48pt Password field and persistent label; Q2 preserves exact two paragraphs with 6pt gap and 46pt local Done >=44pt onscreen. Density tasks refine composition without undoing these contracts.
Lower hierarchy/spacing/Account scores reflect an explicit density reappraisal of current evidence, not an invented regression or forced target.
method: Independent review: all51 historical sheets covering537 native PNGs; all20 recheck originals; 26 historical full-resolution originals; both reference sheets covering17 usable Apple references plus6 reference originals;27 distributed frames from9 recordings. Reviewed current board/list/row/geometry, SignIn/LMRChrome, Account/persistence, settings, Activity SwiftUI/UIKit line budget and targeted test sources. No other round6 scores or parent density plan read. No device/build/code mutation.
